package_contents.mechanism: Dual anti-fibrotic: (A) synthetic CD47-mimetic glycan surface (5e12 molecules/cm²) + (B) IL-10 analog released from PLGA polymer matrix (0.5 mg/cm², 7-day half-life, inflammation-proportional feedback)
package_contents.manufacturing_result: R316/p20_manufacture/P-20_MANUFACTURING_PACKAGE.json — IL-10 release 2468 ng/cm²/day at day 30 (24,680x above 0.1 threshold), 4/4 attacks survived
package_contents.comparator: Standard silicone catheter (no glycan, no IL-10, fibrotic encapsulation rate 10-15%)
package_contents.evidence_tier: MODELLED (PLGA kinetics from published data, wet-lab validation required)

decisive_wet_lab_protocol.hypothesis: IL-10 release from PLGA matrix sustains >= 0.1 ng/cm²/day for 30 days in CSF-like conditions
required_equipment: ELISA kit for IL-10 quantification (detection limit < 0.01 ng/mL)
decisive_wet_lab_protocol.sample_size: 10 catheter segments (3 time points × 3 samples + 1 backup)
measurable_endpoints: IL-10 concentration in aCSF (ng/mL) at days 1, 7, 14, 30
decisive_wet_lab_protocol.pass_fail_criterion: IL-10 release rate >= 0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 (sustained) AND total release < 10 µmol/cm² (toxicity limit)
decisive_wet_lab_protocol.expected_information_gain: High — directly validates the core mechanism. If PASS, P-20 moves to pre-clinical. If FAIL, identifies whether failure is PLGA kinetics (switch polymer) or IL-10 stability (switch protein).
decisive_wet_lab_protocol.buyer_evaluation_instructions: Clone the executable model. Run the simulation. Then commission the wet-lab protocol at any biomaterials lab. Compare measured release to model prediction. The model predicts 2468 ng/cm²/day at day 30; the wet-lab should confirm within 2x.

economics.current_cost: Fibrotic encapsulation causes 10-15% of shunt revisions. $35-50K per revision surgery.
economics.intervention_cost: PLGA-IL-10 coating adds ~$50-100 per catheter (manufacturing cost at scale)
economics.counterfactual: If P-20 reduces fibrotic encapsulation from 10% to 2%, saves $35-50K per avoided revision. Net value per 1000 patients: $2.8M-4.0M/year (MODELLED).
economics.path_to_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED: Wet-lab IL-10 release validation + animal model fibrosis study

differentiation.prior_art: Passive anti-fouling coatings (phosphorylcholine, PEG) exist. NO active immune tolerance mechanism with feedback-controlled IL-10 release exists in shunt literature.
differentiation.technical_delta: Active adaptive immune tolerance (glycan + feedback IL-10) vs passive coatings. Differentiated by: (1) dual mechanism, (2) feedback release, (3) targets fibrosis (not just thrombosis).
differentiation.counsel_questions: Does the glycan-IL-10 combination raise combination patent issues? Is PLGA-IL-10 release covered by existing drug-eluting stent patents?
